Title: Release of Service Fabric SDK 2.1.150 and runtime 5.1.150

Body.Content:
Azure Service Fabric SDK 2.1.150 has been released. This release includes new features and important bug fixes. You can get the updated SDK from the following links:

  • Runtime, SDK, and tools for Visual Studio 2015 (requires Visual Studio 2015 Update 2)
  • Runtime, SDK, and tools for Visual Studio “15” Preview
  • Runtime and SDK only (no tools)

An update to the preview of the standalone installer for Windows Server has also been released, based on runtime 5.1.150.

For more information, see the release announcement on the Service Fabric team blog.
